name: Ground Turkey, Potatoes & Peas with Crusty Bread

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add ground turkey and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until browned and crumbly, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp virgin coconut oil
1 ½ lb ground turkey

instructions.primary_message: Add onion and garlic and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Wash, peel, and large dice potatoes. Wash and medium dice tomatoes. Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Measure out peas.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium yellow potatoes
2 tomatoes
1 small bunch cilantro
2 cups frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Add potatoes, tomatoes, ½ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing), frozen peas, tomato sauce, oregano, cumin, and salt; stir well. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook until potatoes are tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place in a bowl and garnish with remaining cilantro. Enjoy!
